analysis: All 8 rules of the two classes aab -> ababa and aab -> babaa terminate on every word of length <= 12 (rightmost and leftmost strategies agree on every word, and agree with the exact maximal derivation length on all words of length <= 8, as random descent predicts). D(n) for aab -> ababa is 0, 0, 1, 3, 7, ..., 1023 = 2^(n-2) - 1; for aab -> babaa 0, 0, 1, 2, 3, 6, 9, 14, 21, 30, 45, 62 = max_b b(2^floor((n-b)/2) - 1); the per-word formula for aab -> babaa matches every word of length <= 12.
assumptions: all words over {a, b} of length <= 12 (formulas) and <= 8 (exhaustive maximal derivations)
the 8 rules of the two symmetry classes (reversal, letter exchange) are checked separately
falsification: A word whose strategies give different lengths (would contradict random descent), a word whose derivation does not end within 10^6 steps, or any mismatch with the formulas.
